name: Platforms Marquee
description: A heading row over two infinite logo marquees scrolling in opposite directions, edge-faded and pausing on hover; each tile is a colored rounded tile with a token-SVG glyph.
interactions: two rows scroll infinitely via a CSS transform loop (wpmn-pm-scroll, translateX(calc(-50% - gap/2)), 55s linear infinite); each track holds the tile set duplicated for a seamless loop
the second row runs in reverse (.pm-rev sets animation-direction:reverse)
hovering the rows pauses both tracks (animation-play-state:paused)
tiles scale 1.05 and cast a token drop-shadow on hover (300ms); the link arrow slides 6px on hover
both row edges fade with an alpha mask-image
prefers-reduced-motion: the marquee animation and tile transitions are off (tracks render static)
